source: Many, many humans arrived. Most wore black. Some were painted on the face. Everyone in the area came. Those in the woods. Those in the settlement. All whispered. All bowed their heads. All gathered around a hole. More grass was gone. An important human is dead. Boxed. Lowered into the ground. His stone slab is big. Biggest in the enclosure. Big enough that I see the markings in the stone. M-A-Y-O-R A-S-B-U-R-Y. The small humans ripped my flowers. Tossed them on the box. Into the earth. I wonder. What did this dead human do? What is important to humans? Did he give much life? Did he take much life? Is he worth a meadow? A billion blades of grass? Ten billion stories? That night. Something incredible happened. Miraculous. Humans returned. Lit sticks that blazed up. Flew up high. As if among stars. THUNDER! A bright explosion. Sparking. Falling. Like snow made of light. They did this a dozen times. The small humans squealed. Boundless. Humans are boundless creatures. I can imagine. Grass would say: now this is a good story. Grass would remember. Then years pass. And Grass would ask – do you remember? The thunder and the snow made of light? I would, then, because of Grass. The Grass I grew up with. The Grass who joked when in pain. What a cruel thing. To realize: I had a brother. Only when my brother is gone.
target: 好多、好多人類來了。大多穿黑色。有些臉上畫著顏色。這一帶的人全來了。樹林裡的。聚落裡的。全都低聲說話。全都垂著頭。全都圍著一個洞。又少了一片草。 一個重要的人類死了。裝進箱子。放進地裡。他的石板很大。圍欄裡最大的一塊。大得讓我看得清石上的記號。阿、斯、伯、里、鎮、長。小人類扯下我的花。丟到箱子上。丟進土裡。 我想。這個死去的人類做過什麼？人類看重什麼？他給予過很多生命嗎？他奪走過很多生命嗎？他抵得上一片草地嗎？十億片草葉？百億個故事？ 那一夜。發生了不可思議的事。奇蹟。人類回來了。點燃棍子，火光竄起。飛得好高。像飛進星辰之間。雷鳴！明亮的爆炸。火花四散。落下。像光做成的雪。他們重複了十幾次。小人類尖叫。 無窮無盡。人類是無窮無盡的生物。 我能想像。草會說：這才是個好故事。草會記得。然後，歲月過去。草會問——你記得嗎？那雷鳴，還有光做成的雪？那時我會記得，因為草。和我一起長大的草。疼痛時還會開玩笑的草。 多殘酷。 直到明白：我曾有個兄弟。 卻是在兄弟離去之後。

My Beloved, I’ve hardly had time to rest the old rump this past week! 

All the moving and ceremony and political dancing… Oya, how do the wealthy have patience for all this stupidity? To think, all because our son is now a folk hero Snail Lord. 

I was deeply depressed the whole of the time leading up to the duel. Kwyn kept assuring me he had a plan for his fight against Lord Sharoof in the Judgement Pit. (I can hardly
target:
我的摯愛，過去這一週，我這把老骨頭幾乎沒時間坐下歇歇！

又是搬家，又是典禮，又是政治上的周旋……噢呀，有錢人哪來耐心忍受這些蠢事？想想看，全因我們兒子如今成了平民英雄、蝸領主。

決鬥前那段日子，我一直鬱鬱寡歡。奎恩不斷保證，他已想好如何在審判鬥坑對付沙魯夫領主。（那些血法、血這個血那個的瘋話，我簡直

And there he emerged, our little boy, in the Judgement Pit with dirty robes and muddy feet. Standing in the very arena he created. After its use as a blood-theater was revealed to Kwyn, he was burdened by such resentment that he gave up all the

然後，他出現了。我們的小男孩，穿著髒袍子，雙腳沾泥，走進審判鬥坑。站在自己親手建造的競技場裡。得知這裡被拿來上演血腥戲碼後，奎恩憤恨難平，放棄了身為工程師得到的所有

source:
status and wealth he gained as an engineer. (He has your heart, my dear!) Strangely, this horrible place for death was built on the preserved ruins of an ancient round structure with a rusted plaque reading “Asbury Library.” 

I believe you told me of this once, Daneve. A Library. A palace overflowing with books and knowledge. If there is such a place, I hope you are there, my love. 

Lord Sharoof then entered the arena to the roar of a crowd drunk on rice wine and bloodlust. His golden
target:
地位與財富。（親愛的，他有妳的心！）奇怪的是，這個可怕的死亡場所，竟建在一座保留下來的古代圓形建築廢墟上。鏽蝕的牌匾寫著「阿斯伯里圖書館」。

我想，丹妮芙，妳曾跟我說過這種地方。圖書館。滿溢著書籍與知識的殿堂。如果真有這樣的地方，我希望妳就在那裡，我的愛。

接著，沙魯夫領主入場，觀眾醉於米酒與嗜血慾望，爆出吼聲。他金色的

armor and pike were as impeccable as they were frightening. It seemed the whole of the Mire Lands had attended this highly advertised fight. “A powerful Snail Lord fighting a wayward Mudfoot for the love of a beauty!” I left the arena. I could not watch. Our son…

POW! A great crack brought dead silence over the arena. I rushed inside, elbowed my way through the standing onlookers and saw Kwyn holding a gun over the body of the dead Snail Lord. I had only ever read

about such weapons. Oya… from the moment the crowd erupted, time has been a blur. 

Per the laws of the Massuma Empire, Leyál gained all the property, goods, and riches of her deceased husband. She quickly remarried Kwyn, who was then forced to take the title of Snail Lord – a silken prison. He must “bear himself royally,” he cannot change laws, and he must publicly show gratitude and loyalty to the Emperor Massuma.
